name: Mukhyamantri Tirth Yatra Yojana
benefit:
1. Under this scheme, the facility is provided to senior citizens who wish to visit religious destinations such as Ayodhya, Varanasi, Nanded Sahib, Patna Sahib, Ajmer Sharif, and other such destinations in India.
   1. The Scheme also ensures that constraints of travel and local arrangements do not hinder senior citizens from undertaking the journey.
   1. The Government shall bear the cost of Rai
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a bonafide resident of Haryana.
   1. The applicant should possess a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID).
   1. The applicant should have completed 60 years of age (as on 1st January of the year in which the application is made for availing the scheme). Relaxation in age may be given to the spouse accompanying the applicant.
   1. The applicant can avail the benefit of the scheme once every three years.
   1. Family Income of the applicant from all known sources should be upto ₹1,80,000/- per annum as verified by PPP.
   1. The attendant should be a bonafide resident of Haryana with Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID).
